register.labelZh: LOCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: LOCK 片語動詞可讓你說明如何鎖好店舖、房屋、護照、保險箱或貴重物品。；你可以用 lock somebody in 和 lock somebody out,說明某人被關在裏面或被關在外面。；lock yourself out 可用來說明把鑰匙留在裏面,結果自己無法進入的常見情況。；lock onto 和 lock in on 可用來談論攝影機、掃描器、機械人和其他追蹤科技。；lock yourself away 可以表示某人為了溫習、寫作或完成重要工作而獨處。
register.summaryEn: LOCK expressions help you explain how a shop, house, passport, safe or valuable item is protected. You can use lock somebody in and lock somebody out to describe both sides of a closed door. Lock yourself out helps you explain the familiar problem of leaving your key inside and being unable to enter. Lock onto and lock in on are useful when talking about cameras, scanners, robots and other tracking technology. Lock yourself away can show that someone stays alone to study, write or finish an important task.
